description: Source code for VC (Verifiable Credentials) generator and management within the AgentField SDK, including classes for VC data structures, a generator class for creating and verifying VCs, and a context manager for automatic VC generation during execution.

classes.name: ExecutionVC
classes.description: Represents a verifiable credential for an execution.

classes.name: VCGenerator
classes.description: Handles generation, verification, and management of verifiable credentials, including interaction with the AgentField server.

classes.name: VCContext
classes.description: Context manager for automatic VC generation during code execution.

methods.name: generate_execution_vc
methods.description: Generate a verifiable credential for an execution.

methods.name: get_workflow_vc_chain
methods.description: Retrieve the complete VC chain for a workflow.

methods.name: create_workflow_vc
methods.description: Create a workflow-level VC aggregating execution VCs.

methods.name: is_enabled
methods.description: Check if VC generation is enabled.

methods.name: _serialize_data_for_json
methods.description: Serialize data for JSON transmission as base64-encoded string.

methods.name: _parse_execution_vc
methods.description: Parse execution VC from API response.

methods.name: _parse_workflow_vc
methods.description: Parse workflow VC from API response.
